rules.name: rrr-deal-changes-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT t.trade_id, upper(split_part(t.contract_number, '_', 1)) AS client_prefix, t.contract_number, t.deal_status, CAST(coalesce(l.active_lots, 0) AS numeric(30, 6)) AS active_lots FROM opera_backup_04_10.cloned_deal_ticket_table t LEFT JOIN opera_backup_04_10.latest_active_lot l ON l.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND l.business_unit = t.business_unit AND l.trade_id = t.trade_id WHERE t.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND t.business_unit = :bu AND t.is_latest_version = 1 AND upper(split_part(t.contract_number, '_', 1)) IN ('DCS', 'SND', 'BFA', 'AST', 'BOV', 'DAI')

SELECT t.trade_id, upper(split_part(t.contract_number, '_', 1)) AS client_prefix, t.contract_number, t.deal_status, CAST(coalesce(l.active_lots, 0) AS numeric(30, 6)) AS active_lots FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table t LEFT JOIN opera.latest_active_lot l ON l.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND l.business_unit = t.business_unit AND l.trade_id = t.trade_id WHERE t.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND t.business_unit = :bu AND t.is_latest_version = 1 AND upper(split_part(t.contract_number, '_', 1)) IN ('DCS', 'SND', 'BFA', 'AST', 'BOV', 'DAI')
